suggestedGitHubRepo.name: powershell-ops-toolkit
suggestedGitHubRepo.description: Reusable PowerShell helpers and operator tooling for finding, opening, validating, and managing local projects, repos, deployments, and content workflows.

tools.name: Start-LocalSite
tools.description: Start a local site preview from a supplied project path using the existing reusable local-site-preview skill.

tools.name: Find-LocalRepo
tools.description: Find and rank local folders associated with a GitHub repository using Git remotes, folder names, configured project roots, and confidence scoring.

tools.name: New-OpsTool
tools.description: Scaffold new PowerShell Ops Toolkit tools using the lean default structure or optional extended capability folders for schemas, prompts, templates, agents, fixtures, docs, and examples.

tools.name: Open-Project
tools.description: Resolve a project using Find-LocalRepo and open the best local match in VS Code, Explorer, GitHub, or Vercel.

tools.name: Get-ProjectStatus
tools.description: Show branch, dirty files, ahead/behind state, remote, last commit, package manager, framework, and deployment configuration.

tools.name: Start-Project
tools.description: Find a repo, detect package manager and available dev scripts, start the correct local development command, and optionally open the browser.

tools.name: Test-Project
tools.description: Detect and run available lint, typecheck, test, and build scripts and return a compact PASS/FAIL summary.

tools.name: Get-ProjectLinks
tools.description: Return known local, GitHub, Vercel, production, preview, Wix, and Notion links associated with a project.

tools.name: Open-ProjectStack
tools.description: Open the local repo, GitHub repo, production site, Vercel dashboard, and mapped project resources in one command.

tools.name: Compare-RepoCopies
tools.description: Find duplicate local copies of a repo and compare remote, branch, last commit, modified date, dirty state, and file counts.

tools.name: Get-RepoHealth
tools.description: Check Git metadata, lockfiles, stale build artifacts, generated files, scripts, environment examples, and workspace-root issues.

tools.name: Find-ProjectAsset
tools.description: Search registries for tools, GPTs, calculators, CTAs, content, repos, forms, lead magnets, or partner assets related to a keyword.

tools.name: Export-ProjectContext
tools.description: Generate a compact Markdown or JSON project brief with repo metadata, architecture, important files, scripts, routes, recent commits, URLs, and TODOs.

tools.name: Get-ChangedFiles
tools.description: Show meaningful modified and untracked files while filtering build artifacts, caches, logs, and generated output.

tools.name: Get-WorkQueue
tools.description: Retrieve open GitHub issues and pull requests for a repo and sort them into a practical current execution queue.

tools.name: Open-GitHubRepo
tools.description: Accept a repo name, URL, or local directory and open the canonical GitHub repository.

tools.name: Open-VercelProject
tools.description: Resolve a local repo to a mapped Vercel project and open its dashboard or production URL.

tools.name: New-ProjectTask
tools.description: Prepare a clean GitHub issue or task from current repo context, defaulting to preview-only until explicitly authorized to create it.

tools.name: Get-SiteRoutes
tools.description: Scan app, pages, content JSON, and dynamic routes to produce the actual route inventory for a site.

tools.name: Test-SiteRoutes
tools.description: Check routes for missing content files, duplicate slugs, dead internal links, invalid JSON contracts, and missing metadata.

tools.name: Get-ContentInventory
tools.description: Pull or reconcile blog posts, landing pages, videos, lead magnets, CTAs, tools, and affiliate resources into one inventory.

tools.name: Find-ContentGap
tools.description: Compare a planned topic against existing content to flag duplication, cannibalization, missing internal links, and AEO opportunities.

tools.name: New-ContentBrief
tools.description: Generate title, keyword cluster, slug, excerpt, meta description, outline, CTA, internal links, FAQ schema, and video angle.

tools.name: Get-WixDraftQueue
tools.description: Show unpublished drafts, stale drafts, incomplete SEO metadata, missing featured images, and content ready to publish.

tools.name: Get-DeploymentStatus
tools.description: Show branch, latest GitHub commit, latest Vercel deployment, deployment status, production URL, and whether local HEAD matches deployed HEAD.

tools.name: Invoke-ProjectDoctor
tools.description: Run an umbrella diagnostic across repo health, duplicate copies, Git state, Node version, package manager, lockfiles, scripts, build status, and deployment mapping.

tools.name: Get-SkillInventory
tools.description: Scan the JSON skills directory, validate structure, show commands exposed by each skill, and flag missing docs or duplicate helper names.

tools.name: Search-MyStack
tools.description: Search across repos, Vercel apps, Wix assets, GPTs, tools, Notion databases, and registries from one query.
